decisive_items: epileptiform activity in the right temporo-occipital region
sudden burning pain in the epigastrium lasting 10-50 minutes
response.rationale: Epilepsy fits the episodic autonomic/sensory symptoms (epigastric pain, hallucinations) and right temporo-occipital epileptiform activity on qEEG; PRES lacks seizure activity and has hypertension/vascular pattern not specific.

rejected.why: MRI white matter punctate lesions can be vascular but no posterior reversible findings; no typical PRES features like hypertension crisis or cortical blindness.
Gastroparesis does not explain hallucinations or epileptiform EEG; normal exam and normal enzymes weaken it.
History of GPA not SLE; no serologic or neuropsychiatric lupus-specific findings; hallucinations alone insufficient.
